description: Use when asked about a wallet's overall holdings or worth. One call replaces balance + tokens + activity lookups, and separates priced from unpriced and verified from unverified holdings so the total is not inflated by spam. SOL balance, top token holdings with USD values, total estimated value, and recent activity in one response. Inputs: wallet: The wallet to summarize. network (optional): Solana cluster to read. Defaults to "mainnet-beta" (real funds). Cost: 3 free calls, then $0.001 USDC per call (x402). Full field-by-field docs: GET /api/tools/wallet_snapshot.
name: wallet_snapshot
